facts.subject: official_game
facts.claim: The official Roblox experience is Tank Game, listed as 💥 Tank Game! [2.4] at /games/119789365111500/Tank-Game. Roblox classifies it as Simulation / Incremental Simulator. The universe was created on 2025-08-23.

facts.subject: developer
facts.claim: Tank Game is created by the verified Roblox group 7x3 (community id 111185671). The game page credits the experience as By 7x3.

facts.subject: place_id
facts.claim: The root place ID for Tank Game is 119789365111500.

facts.subject: universe_id
facts.claim: The universe ID for place 119789365111500 is 8520148363.

facts.subject: developer
facts.claim: 7x3 group 111185671 is a public verified group whose owner is supportTheBlueFan (userId 3994645187). The group description is 'Group for perks, benefits and community!' and public entry is allowed.

facts.subject: gameplay
facts.claim: The official description's HOW TO PLAY loop is: shoot at food for levels; level up and upgrade stats; destroy tanks and earn gems; unlock over 150 unique tanks. Stat examples named on the page are damage, health, and speed.

facts.subject: gameplay
facts.claim: The experience is classified as Simulation / Incremental Simulator, with a 20-player server cap.

facts.subject: faq
facts.claim: As of this check, the official Roblox description lists four promo codes: REBALANCEAGAIN for 250,000 XP, HAVEFUN for 200,000 XP, NEWCURRENCY for 50,000 gems, and HEADSTART for 25,000 gems. Secondary code lists disagree on older codes, so only these four were verified on the official page.

facts.subject: mistake
facts.claim: The official description warns that all exploiters are permanently banned and that an exploiting ban cannot be appealed.

facts.subject: gameplay
facts.claim: Default keyboard controls reported by BloxInformer: WASD to move, E to open the stats upgrade menu, and Q to open the tank upgrade menu.

facts.subject: gameplay
facts.claim: New tanks get a short spawn-immunity window so they can shoot food and start building before other players can fight them.

facts.subject: progression
facts.claim: The first tank-class upgrade becomes available at level 15 through the Q menu. BloxInformer lists Double, Scout, Spammer, Side, Grinder, and Freezer as level-15 options, with Flame listed as available to 7x3 group members.

facts.subject: progression
facts.claim: Further tank-class upgrades appear around every 15 levels and often require a specific prior path. BloxInformer says tanks at level 60 and above must first be unlocked in the lobby Tanks Shop using Diamonds earned from play.

facts.subject: gameplay
facts.claim: BloxInformer's beginner guide recommends putting early stat points into bullet damage and bullet health so your shots can pierce weaker enemy bullets after spawn immunity ends, then investing in max HP or HP regen.

facts.subject: gameplay
facts.claim: Beebom describes the start as spawning as a small circular tank with a single turret, then shooting colorful cubes and other shapes for XP. Later upgrades can add turrets or change shots to flame or freeze, and can raise damage, regeneration, and bullet speed.

facts.subject: gameplay
facts.claim: Official badges confirm that arena 'food' includes geometric shapes: squares (The Fun is Starting! / Square Dominator!), triangles (This is Better.. / Trigonometry!), and pentagons (Reinforced! / Pentagon Official!), with 100-destroy and 10,000-destroy variants.

facts.subject: progression
facts.claim: Sportskeeda reports that Diamonds (also called gems in the official description and most code lists) are the primary shop currency. They buy tank upgrades in the Tank Shop and raise per-stat capacity. The same page says each attribute starts with a 7-point cap that gems can raise.

facts.subject: faq
facts.claim: Promo codes are redeemed in-game through a blue tick or checkmark icon on the left side of the screen (Sportskeeda says it is next to Settings). Players type or paste the code into the Enter code here field and press Redeem.

facts.subject: faq
facts.claim: GamesRadar and Sportskeeda both report that Tank Game codes are not case-sensitive. Sportskeeda also shows an already-redeemed error: each working code can be claimed only once per account.

facts.subject: mistake
facts.claim: GamesRadar warns that the game does not pause while the codes menu is open. Unless the player is in the lobby, other tanks can still shoot and eliminate them during redemption, so codes should be claimed before entering a match.

facts.subject: faq
facts.claim: Multiple secondary outlets point players to Discord invite https://discord.com/invite/WgCdbaMrrq (codes channel) for new codes, and to the 7x3 Roblox group for exclusive in-game upgrades or rewards. Beebom, Pocket Tactics, Sportskeeda, Eurogamer, and Destructoid all cite the same Discord invite.

facts.subject: progression
facts.claim: Destructoid (updated 2026-05-26) says the game now includes an Index that shows tank build paths. It recommends maxing Damage and Fire Rate for ranged tanks (Penetration and Laser Range on Rail) and Health, Body Damage, and Speed for melee tanks.

facts.subject: mistake
facts.claim: Destructoid argues that omnidirectional tanks (side and rear barrels) are weaker in direct PVP because that DPS cannot be aimed, even if they farm well in the middle of the map. Frontal-barrel tanks are described as the more reliable PVP choice.

facts.subject: progression
facts.claim: BloxInformer lists later class gates at about level 30, 42, 60+, 80+, 90+, 105+ (Railgun), 130+, and 150+ (including Orchestra and Double Railgun). A comment on that page dated 2026-01-23 says some listed paths are wrong or missing, so the tree should be checked in the in-game Index.

facts.subject: gameplay
facts.claim: Destructoid lists Flame as a group-join tank and Mega Freezer as a diamond-shop tank, treating both as strong close-range multi-fight options. That matches BloxInformer's claim that Flame is a group-member unlock at the first class choice.

facts.subject: update
facts.claim: The Roblox games API reported the universe last updated on 2026-08-17, and the live display name includes version tag [2.4].

facts.subject: gameplay
facts.claim: The Roblox game-passes API for this universe returned only one pass named hello (id 1480340364), with isForSale=false. No priced, on-sale gamepasses were listed through that endpoint.

facts.subject: gameplay
facts.claim: Rolimon's lists additional universe places besides the root, including Tank Game! [STARTER], [PRO], [MEGA], [STAGING], Tank Game! [TRADING], and Red VS Blue. Their exact matchmaking rules were not verified in-game.

first_10_minutes: Join Tank Game by 7x3 (place 119789365111500). The live listing name is 💥 Tank Game! [2.4].

If you are in a lobby, open the blue tick/checkmark on the left and redeem the codes currently printed on the official Roblox page (as of this check: REBALANCEAGAIN, HAVEFUN, NEWCURRENCY, HEADSTART). Do not open the codes menu in a live fight; the game does not pause.
On spawn you have a short immunity window. Use WASD to move and shoot food (squares, triangles, pentagons, and other colored shapes) for XP.
Press E and spend the first stat points on bullet damage and bullet health so your shots can contest other tanks after immunity ends.
At level 15, press Q and pick a first class (Double, Scout, Spammer, Side, Grinder, or Freezer). Flame is reported as a 7x3 group-member option.
core_loop: Shoot food shapes to gain XP and levels.
Spend a stat point on each level (E menu) to raise damage, health, speed, fire rate, bullet health, regen, or related stats.
At class-upgrade levels (about every 15 levels, starting at 15), press Q to evolve the tank along a path.
Destroy other tanks to earn gems/diamonds, then spend them in the Tanks Shop and on raising stat caps.
Optional: join the 7x3 group for reported exclusive tanks/upgrades such as Flame.
progression_path: Level 0–14: farm food under spawn immunity, stack bullet damage and bullet health, then HP or regen.
Level 15: first class via Q; later classes depend on that path.
Around every 15 levels: another class upgrade. Use the in-game Index rather than third-party trees if they conflict.
Spend gems/diamonds to raise the per-stat point cap (Sportskeeda says the starting cap is 7) and to unlock shop tanks.
Level 60+ shop tanks, then later gates around 90 / 105 (Railgun) / 130 / 150 (Orchestra, Double Railgun) as listed by secondary wikis. Confirm in-game.
Ranged builds: Destructoid recommends Damage and Fire Rate (Penetration and Laser Range on Rail). Melee builds: Health, Body Damage, and Speed.
common_mistakes: Opening the codes UI in a live arena instead of the lobby; other players can still kill you.
Typing expired or mistyped codes, or retrying a code already redeemed on the account.
Ignoring bullet health: after spawn immunity, weaker bullets lose the trade against stronger ones.
Picking omnidirectional (side/back barrel) tanks if the goal is 1v1 PVP; frontal barrels are described as more reliable.
Treating third-party tank trees as complete; BloxInformer itself notes missing and wrong paths.
Using exploits; the official page says exploiting bans are permanent and unappealable.
Confusing this 7x3 game with unrelated Roblox titles also named Tank Simulator or Tank Game Simulator.
faq: Who made Tank Game? Verified Roblox group 7x3 (id 111185671), owned by supportTheBlueFan.
How do I level up? Shoot food shapes for XP, then spend points with E and evolve with Q.
How do I get gems? Official text: destroy tanks and earn gems. Codes also grant gems or XP.
How do I redeem codes? Blue tick/checkmark on the left, enter the code, press Redeem. Codes are reported as not case-sensitive and one-time.
Which codes are confirmed today? Only the four printed on the official Roblox description; secondary lists conflict on older codes.
Is there a Discord? Secondary guides cite https://discord.com/invite/WgCdbaMrrq.
Is the Fandom wiki official? The Fandom home itself says it is unofficial until BlueFan approves it.

uncertainties: Secondary code lists disagree as of 2026-08-19. The official Roblox page lists only REBALANCEAGAIN, HAVEFUN, NEWCURRENCY, and HEADSTART. Pocket Tactics (updated 2026-08-18) and GamesRadar (updated 2026-08-17) add many older codes; Eurogamer's working list is much shorter and stale; Beebom (2026-08-01) and Destructoid (2026-08-17) still list seasonal codes that other pages mark expired (for example SANTASGEMS, RESTINPEACE, TRICKORTREAT). No in-game redemption check was run.
Official text uses gems; BloxInformer and Sportskeeda often say Diamonds for the same shop/stat-cap currency. It is not proven whether they are one currency with two names or two separate currencies.
The starting per-stat cap of 7 is reported only by Sportskeeda (2026-06-30) and may have changed by version 2.4.

BloxInformer's tank tree is incomplete and contested by its own comments. Destructoid removed its build-path section because an in-game Index exists. Exact recipes, gem costs, and which tanks are currently on-sale were not verified in-game.

Exact spawn-immunity duration, food XP values, level XP curve, and full E-menu stat names/caps (Fandom snippets mention Damage, Bullet Speed, Fire Rate, Bullet Health, Max Health, Health Regen, Body Damage, Tank Speed, plus gem-then-Robux cap raises) were not confirmed on a reachable official page.
The Roblox game-passes endpoint only returned an offsale pass named hello. Destructoid still mentions a P2W tank called Titan. Current paid products, developer products, and prices are unverified.
Rolimon's extra places (STARTER, PRO, MEGA, TRADING, Red VS Blue, STAGING) exist as names, but queue rules, level gates, and which one new players should pick were not documented.

The Fandom wiki at https://official-tank-game.fandom.com/wiki/Official_Tank_Game_Wiki was not readable here (Cloudflare challenge) and its own home snippet says it is unofficial until BlueFan approves it.
Exact in-game reward for joining 7x3 is not specified beyond group 'perks' plus secondary reports that Flame is a group tank.
Live CCU, visits, likes, and favorites change constantly and were not stored as evergreen facts.
forbidden_claims: Do not treat Tank Simulator (https://www.roblox.com/games/15737628171/Tank-Simulator) or Tank Game Simulator (https://www.roblox.com/games/17554856486/Tank-Game-Simulator) as this game.
Do not publish a canonical currently-working codes list beyond the four strings on the official Roblox description without a fresh in-game check; secondary lists conflict.
Do not present the Fandom 'Official Tank Game Wiki' as developer-approved; it labels itself unofficial until BlueFan approves it.
Do not treat BloxInformer's full tank table as complete or current.
Do not invent gem/diamond prices, XP tables, or a full skill tree.
